descriptions.general: Basic application settings and appearance configuration
descriptions.pet: Desktop pet display and management settings

language.title: Language
language.description: Select the display language of the application

theme.title: Theme Mode
theme.description: Select the theme appearance of the application

autoStart.title: Launch at Startup
autoStart.description: Automatically run the application when the system starts

minimizeToTray.title: Minimize to System Tray on Close
minimizeToTray.description: Minimize to system tray when clicking the close button, normal minimize will still show in taskbar

disguiseMode.title: Disguise Mode
disguiseMode.description: When enabled, image covers will be randomly replaced with images from the disguise folder for privacy protection

safetyKey.title: Safety Key
safetyKey.description: Quickly minimize and open a safety webpage when pressing ESC
safetyKey.shortcutDesc: Enter a custom safety key shortcut (e.g., Esc, Ctrl+Q)
safetyKey.urlDesc: The webpage URL to open when pressing ESC

showWindowShortcut.title: Enable Show Window Shortcut
showWindowShortcut.description: When enabled, set a shortcut to restore the application from the system tray
showWindowShortcut.shortcutDesc: Press this shortcut to restore the application from the system tray

saveData.title: Save Data Folder Location
saveData.description: Select the save location for the save data folder
saveData.customPathDesc: Select a custom directory for saving data
saveData.openFolderDesc: Open the application save data folder in file explorer

autoBackup.title: Enable Auto Backup
autoBackup.description: When enabled, the system will automatically backup the entire save directory at the specified interval
autoBackup.intervalDesc: Set the time interval for automatic backup of the entire save
autoBackup.maxCountDesc: Set the number of backups to keep during auto backup, old backups beyond this number will be automatically deleted

personalization.customAppTitleDesc: Set the title displayed in the sidebar
personalization.customAppSubtitleDesc: Set the subtitle displayed in the sidebar
personalization.backgroundImageDesc: Set a custom background image for all pages
personalization.clearBackgroundDesc: Remove the currently set background image
